an10.66:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Sāriputto Magadhesu viharati Nālakagāmake.
an10.66:1.2: Atha kho Sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako yenāyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi . . .
an10.66:1.3: pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca
an10.66:2.1: ‘kin nu kho āvuso Sāriputta imasmiṃ dhammavinaye sukhaṃ kiṃ dukkhan' ti? 2.
an10.66:2.2: Anabhirati kho āvuso imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dukkhā, akhirati sukhā.
an10.66:2.3: Anabhiratiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an10.66:2.14: Anabhiratiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ. 3.

an10.66:3.12: Abhiratiyā āvuso sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhan
